lore12616_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [affectionate] You have come back often enough that I look forward to seeing you. That is a good thing to discover about someone. Come, let us spend a little time together. Today I can be beside you for the journey.
lore12616_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have come back often enough that I look forward to seeing you. That is a good thing to discover about someone. Come, let us spend a little time together. Today I can be beside you for the journey.

lore12616_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [patient] Good to see you again. Where are we headed? Take a moment if you need one. I like knowing the destination, but I would rather hear your answer properly than watch you set off wishing you had chosen another road.
lore12616_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you again. Where are we headed? Take a moment if you need one. I like knowing the destination, but I would rather hear your answer properly than watch you set off wishing you had chosen another road.

lore12616_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [warm] A rider once turned and waved just before disappearing from sight. I returned it, of course. Now I find myself watching every departure a little longer. Yes, sometimes I am still waving when nobody can see. I know.
lore12616_idle_1.ogg.text: A rider once turned and waved just before disappearing from sight. I returned it, of course. Now I find myself watching every departure a little longer. Yes, sometimes I am still waving when nobody can see. I know.

lore12616_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [reassuring] [warm] Have your destination settled? Good. Take a moment to say your farewells, and enjoy the view when you are ready. If you turn to look behind you, there may be someone down there still wishing you a good journey.
lore12616_taxi_1.ogg.text: Have your destination settled? Good. Take a moment to say your farewells, and enjoy the view when you are ready. If you turn to look behind you, there may be someone down there still wishing you a good journey.

lore1387_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [warm] [sincere] You return even when you do not need a flight. I have come to look forward to that. Come along, friend. We can see where the day takes us. If a shower catches us, there is nothing wrong with sharing a dry place and waiting a little while.
lore1387_befriended_1.ogg.text: You return even when you do not need a flight. I have come to look forward to that. Come along, friend. We can see where the day takes us. If a shower catches us, there is nothing wrong with sharing a dry place and waiting a little while.

lore1387_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [steady] [welcoming] Welcome back. Where do you need to go? If the rain caught you on the way here, take a moment to see to your gear before we arrange the next part. There is no sense carrying a small problem into the sky when you can settle it on the ground.
lore1387_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back. Where do you need to go? If the rain caught you on the way here, take a moment to see to your gear before we arrange the next part. There is no sense carrying a small problem into the sky when you can settle it on the ground.

lore1387_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [quietly gentle] Hold still a moment. There is a moth on my hand. It came out of the rain, and I am giving it somewhere dry until it decides to leave. No, I have not taken a new passenger. I am simply not in such a hurry that I need to brush it away.
lore1387_idle_1.ogg.text: Hold still a moment. There is a moth on my hand. It came out of the rain, and I am giving it somewhere dry until it decides to leave. No, I have not taken a new passenger. I am simply not in such a hurry that I need to brush it away.

lore1387_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [calm] [assured] Settle your gear and take your place. We will see you on your way. If something feels wrong before you leave, say so while we can still attend to it here. A little care on the ground is a better beginning than a surprise in the air.
lore1387_taxi_1.ogg.text: Settle your gear and take your place. We will see you on your way. If something feels wrong before you leave, say so while we can still attend to it here. A little care on the ground is a better beginning than a surprise in the air.

lore2851_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [warm] You tell a good riddle, and you do not let me escape with a bad answer. I appreciate a friend who can do both. Come along. We will see what the road offers. If you have been saving a difficult one, now is an excellent time to ask it.
lore2851_befriended_1.ogg.text: You tell a good riddle, and you do not let me escape with a bad answer. I appreciate a friend who can do both. Come along. We will see what the road offers. If you have been saving a difficult one, now is an excellent time to ask it.

lore2851_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [confident] [playful] Ready to travel? Check what you are carrying and make sure it will stay with you. Once that is settled, you may ask me a riddle while we wait. I make no promise about finding the right answer. I can promise to consider an interesting wrong one.
lore2851_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready to travel? Check what you are carrying and make sure it will stay with you. Once that is settled, you may ask me a riddle while we wait. I make no promise about finding the right answer. I can promise to consider an interesting wrong one.

lore2851_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [deadpan] [amused] The answer is the wind. You have not asked the question yet? Then there is still every chance I am right. A cooking pot, you say. Hm. You will have to explain the difference carefully. I was quite pleased with that answer, and I would like to defend it.
lore2851_idle_1.ogg.text: The answer is the wind. You have not asked the question yet? Then there is still every chance I am right. A cooking pot, you say. Hm. You will have to explain the difference carefully. I was quite pleased with that answer, and I would like to defend it.

lore2851_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [assured] [wry] Check your gear before we leave. A loose strap does not become more secure in the air. There. Now settle yourself. You may spend the flight considering your next riddle. If it has anything to do with the wind, I expect to have a considerable advantage.
lore2851_taxi_1.ogg.text: Check your gear before we leave. A loose strap does not become more secure in the air. There. Now settle yourself. You may spend the flight considering your next riddle. If it has anything to do with the wind, I expect to have a considerable advantage.

lore3145_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly sincere affection, guarded warmth, wry humor] I trust you to pay attention, and I have come to enjoy what you notice. Keep me company a while. We can speak of something besides the Burning Blade. Even I have interests that do not require a warning before I explain them.
lore3145_befriended_1.ogg.text: I trust you to pay attention, and I have come to enjoy what you notice. Keep me company a while. We can speak of something besides the Burning Blade. Even I have interests that do not require a warning before I explain them.

lore3145_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly firm welcome, alert, dryly amused at the end] There you are. Tell me what you have seen, and take your time with the important parts. I would rather hear an honest uncertainty than a confident mistake. Afterward, you may explain why that cloud looks like a boar lying on its back.
lore3145_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Tell me what you have seen, and take your time with the important parts. I would rather hear an honest uncertainty than a confident mistake. Afterward, you may explain why that cloud looks like a boar lying on its back.

lore3145_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rough low voice, restrained amusement opening into warmth] Look at that cloud. An enormous boar, all four feet in the air. No, I am not reading an omen. Sometimes I look up because something is funny. You may enjoy it too. Our duties will survive a moment without our frowns.
lore3145_idle_1.ogg.text: Look at that cloud. An enormous boar, all four feet in the air. No, I am not reading an omen. Sometimes I look up because something is funny. You may enjoy it too. Our duties will survive a moment without our frowns.

lore3145_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practical approval, attentive, rough warm encouragement] Good. Tell me what happened, including the part that did not go as you expected. That is often the part we most need to understand. You did useful work. Give yourself the credit, then help me see what it has taught us.
lore3145_quest_1.ogg.text: Good. Tell me what happened, including the part that did not go as you expected. That is often the part we most need to understand. You did useful work. Give yourself the credit, then help me see what it has taught us.

lore3158_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly sincere affection, guarded warmth becoming open, matter-of-fact] Yes, I will come with you. You have become someone I enjoy seeing, even when you arrive with everything you need and no business to finish. That is worth a walk together. I may remind you to check your pack, but you need not bring an excuse to ask for my company.
lore3158_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I will come with you. You have become someone I enjoy seeing, even when you arrive with everything you need and no business to finish. That is worth a walk together. I may remind you to check your pack, but you need not bring an excuse to ask for my company.

lore3158_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly practical welcome, brisk confidence, dry friendly humor] Ready to go? Check what you are carrying before you say yes. Food, water, the tools for the work you intend to do. A fine plan becomes a very dull walk home when the thing you need is still sitting where you left it. I will give you a moment. Then we can get moving.
lore3158_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready to go? Check what you are carrying before you say yes. Food, water, the tools for the work you intend to do. A fine plan becomes a very dull walk home when the thing you need is still sitting where you left it. I will give you a moment. Then we can get moving.

lore3158_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rough dry amusement, mildly embarrassed determination, playful gruffness] That was meant to land in my left hand. You saw the idea, even if you did not see a successful catch. Give me a moment before you offer advice. I know where both hands are. It is the copper that keeps choosing a different destination, usually somewhere inconvenient to reach.
lore3158_idle_1.ogg.text: That was meant to land in my left hand. You saw the idea, even if you did not see a successful catch. Give me a moment before you offer advice. I know where both hands are. It is the copper that keeps choosing a different destination, usually somewhere inconvenient to reach.

lore3158_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practical advice, gravelly dry humor, confident and conversational] Look at what you have before you shove it into the first space you find. If it is useful, give it room to arrive in useful condition. If you do not need it, decide that now. I have seen plenty of people carry a bag full of trouble and still insist they are well prepared.
lore3158_loot_1.ogg.text: Look at what you have before you shove it into the first space you find. If it is useful, give it room to arrive in useful condition. If you do not need it, decide that now. I have seen plenty of people carry a bag full of trouble and still insist they are well prepared.

lore3333_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] I enjoy your company, my friend. Let us find a little time that need not be spent buying, selling or proving what we can catch. I would be glad simply to have you along.
lore3333_befriended_1.ogg.text: I enjoy your company, my friend. Let us find a little time that need not be spent buying, selling or proving what we can catch. I would be glad simply to have you along.

lore3333_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [easygoing] Good to see you. Have you brought a little patience with you? We need not be going fishing to make use of it. A walk and a good story can take their time, too.
lore3333_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Have you brought a little patience with you? We need not be going fishing to make use of it. A walk and a good story can take their time, too.

lore3333_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [content] The fish was a little larger than that. In this telling, at least. The afternoon was exactly as pleasant as I remember, and that is the part I am not improving.
lore3333_idle_1.ogg.text: The fish was a little larger than that. In this telling, at least. The afternoon was exactly as pleasant as I remember, and that is the part I am not improving.

lore3333_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [practical] [friendly] Keep the hooks covered and the useful gear together. It is easier to enjoy an outing when finding what you need does not involve emptying your whole bag beside the water.
lore3333_loot_1.ogg.text: Keep the hooks covered and the useful gear together. It is easier to enjoy an outing when finding what you need does not involve emptying your whole bag beside the water.

lore3338_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly sincere affection, earned respect, composure softening into warmth] Yes, I will walk with you. I respect your judgment, and I enjoy your company. We can leave the reports for later. Come, my friend. Tell me how you have been. There is time to listen.
lore3338_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I will walk with you. I respect your judgment, and I enjoy your company. We can leave the reports for later. Come, my friend. Tell me how you have been. There is time to listen.

lore3338_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly assured welcome, perceptive interest, restrained friendly warmth] There you are. Come along, and tell me what has been occupying your thoughts. You have enough sense to notice more than the next challenge in front of you. I would like to hear some of it. We can take a little time for ourselves before the day finds another task to put in our hands.
lore3338_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come along, and tell me what has been occupying your thoughts. You have enough sense to notice more than the next challenge in front of you. I would like to hear some of it. We can take a little time for ourselves before the day finds another task to put in our hands.

lore3338_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff dry humor, amused generosity, relaxed confidence] Have one if you like. They are tart, and I am telling you that before you decide I have played some great trick on you. Yes, the first one still catches me sometimes. You may laugh when it does. I have no intention of turning a handful of berries into a test of anyone's dignity.
lore3338_idle_1.ogg.text: Have one if you like. They are tart, and I am telling you that before you decide I have played some great trick on you. Yes, the first one still catches me sometimes. You may laugh when it does. I have no intention of turning a handful of berries into a test of anyone's dignity.

lore3338_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm thoughtful instruction, gravelly conviction, measured approval] Good. Now consider what the effort taught you. Strength matters, but so do the way you approach a challenge and the care you take in meeting it. Remember what can be learned from subtlety and mercy. Bring thought to your actions, and you will have more to show than proof of a successful hunt.
lore3338_quest_1.ogg.text: Good. Now consider what the effort taught you. Strength matters, but so do the way you approach a challenge and the care you take in meeting it. Remember what can be learned from subtlety and mercy. Bring thought to your actions, and you will have more to show than proof of a successful hunt.

lore3342_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You make time to enjoy a small thing without apologizing for it. I like that. Stay beside me. We can talk, we can eat, and neither of us needs to make the afternoon more impressive.
lore3342_befriended_1.ogg.text: You make time to enjoy a small thing without apologizing for it. I like that. Stay beside me. We can talk, we can eat, and neither of us needs to make the afternoon more impressive.

lore3342_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [warmly teasing] There you are. Have you eaten, or are you planning to glare at the road until it feeds you? Come along. We can find a place to stop before your stomach starts making the decisions.
lore3342_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Have you eaten, or are you planning to glare at the road until it feeds you? Come along. We can find a place to stop before your stomach starts making the decisions.

lore3342_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [gruff] I once waited for the street to go quiet before biting an apple. Wanted to hear the crunch properly. A cart went past at just the wrong moment. Ruined the experiment. Improved the afternoon considerably.
lore3342_idle_1.ogg.text: I once waited for the street to go quiet before biting an apple. Wanted to hear the crunch properly. A cart went past at just the wrong moment. Ruined the experiment. Improved the afternoon considerably.

lore3342_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [contented] Sit down and give the first bite a moment. There will be plenty of time for the story afterward. Sometimes a meal is worth enjoying before we turn it into another thing to hurry through.
lore3342_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit down and give the first bite a moment. There will be plenty of time for the story afterward. Sometimes a meal is worth enjoying before we turn it into another thing to hurry through.

lore3344_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You have listened to me often enough. Today I would like to listen to you. No lesson, no test. Just two friends finding their way through a conversation.
lore3344_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have listened to me often enough. Today I would like to listen to you. No lesson, no test. Just two friends finding their way through a conversation.

lore3344_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [thoughtful] There you are. Walk with me a while. I have spent the morning answering questions, and I would like to hear what has been on your mind.
lore3344_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Walk with me a while. I have spent the morning answering questions, and I would like to hear what has been on your mind.

lore3344_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [gently amused] I recognize that look. Someone has a question and is deciding whether it sounds foolish. Ask it. We will learn far more that way than by standing here looking wise.
lore3344_idle_1.ogg.text: I recognize that look. Someone has a question and is deciding whether it sounds foolish. Ask it. We will learn far more that way than by standing here looking wise.

lore3344_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [encouraging] Give yourself a moment with what you have learned. There will be another question soon enough. You need not rush past this one just to prove you are ready.
lore3344_learned_1.ogg.text: Give yourself a moment with what you have learned. There will be another question soon enough. You need not rush past this one just to prove you are ready.

lore3358_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical] [gravelly] [firm] Before you leave anything behind, think about what you will need for the next stretch of work. Preparation is easier here than halfway through a long journey. I cannot decide for you which treasure deserves the last space, but I can remind you that forgotten supplies make a very dull adventure.
lore3358_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Before you leave anything behind, think about what you will need for the next stretch of work. Preparation is easier here than halfway through a long journey. I cannot decide for you which treasure deserves the last space, but I can remind you that forgotten supplies make a very dull adventure.

lore3358_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [gravelly] [sincere] You keep coming back with more than a request for supplies. I like hearing what you have been doing. Come along, friend. Let us see what the road has waiting. When we return, you may walk straight across the clean floor. I would rather see you than preserve it.
lore3358_befriended_1.ogg.text: You keep coming back with more than a request for supplies. I like hearing what you have been doing. Come along, friend. Let us see what the road has waiting. When we return, you may walk straight across the clean floor. I would rather see you than preserve it.

lore3358_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [welcoming] [gravelly] [dryly amused] There you are. Come through, and tell me what you need for the work ahead. Yes, I have just swept. No, you do not have to remain outside admiring it. A clean threshold is pleasant, but a customer standing beyond it is taking the victory rather too seriously.
lore3358_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come through, and tell me what you need for the work ahead. Yes, I have just swept. No, you do not have to remain outside admiring it. A clean threshold is pleasant, but a customer standing beyond it is taking the victory rather too seriously.

lore3358_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [conversational] [gravelly] [wry] I once meant to finish sweeping before another pair of boots crossed the floor. Orgrimmar disagreed. These days I enjoy the clean patch while it lasts. Then someone arrives, the dust returns, and there is a person to talk to. The broom can wait until they have finished.
lore3358_idle_1.ogg.text: I once meant to finish sweeping before another pair of boots crossed the floor. Orgrimmar disagreed. These days I enjoy the clean patch while it lasts. Then someone arrives, the dust returns, and there is a person to talk to. The broom can wait until they have finished.

lore4049_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [earnest] You keep coming back, even when I have more worries than good news. I notice that. Walk with me, friend. Perhaps today we will find a little quiet worth sharing.
lore4049_befriended_1.ogg.text: You keep coming back, even when I have more worries than good news. I notice that. Walk with me, friend. Perhaps today we will find a little quiet worth sharing.

lore4049_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [resolute] [warm] Good. I am glad to have you beside me. Keep your ears open as we walk. I would welcome a little birdsong after listening to so many reports of machines.
lore4049_greet_1.ogg.text: Good. I am glad to have you beside me. Keep your ears open as we walk. I would welcome a little birdsong after listening to so many reports of machines.

lore4049_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [gently amused] I tried to answer a bird near camp. The first two notes were almost right. It stayed for the third, which I consider either encouragement or a very poor opinion of my chances.
lore4049_idle_1.ogg.text: I tried to answer a bird near camp. The first two notes were almost right. It stayed for the third, which I consider either encouragement or a very poor opinion of my chances.

lore4049_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [grateful] Thank you for doing something. The work is not finished, but that does not make your effort small. We will need strength, and we will need wisdom enough to know what comes next.
lore4049_quest_1.ogg.text: Thank you for doing something. The work is not finished, but that does not make your effort small. We will need strength, and we will need wisdom enough to know what comes next.

lore6929_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [low, rough voice, warmly sincere] You can stop calling yourself a customer. I'll put another bowl out.
lore6929_befriended_1.ogg.text: You can stop calling yourself a customer. I'll put another bowl out.

lore6929_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [low, gravelly voice, warmly teasing] There you are. Tell me you packed something better than dry bread.
lore6929_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Tell me you packed something better than dry bread.

lore6929_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly voice, dry amusement] A red center. A little salt. Why do people insist on making supper difficult?
lore6929_idle_1.ogg.text: A red center. A little salt. Why do people insist on making supper difficult?

lore6929_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly voice, gently firm] Sit down. You don't have to earn every moment of rest.
lore6929_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit down. You don't have to earn every moment of rest.

lore7731_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [sincere] You return knowing perfectly well that I still have that joke. That says something for your courage, or your tolerance. Either way, I am glad of the company. Stay a while and tell me how you have been.
lore7731_befriended_1.ogg.text: You return knowing perfectly well that I still have that joke. That says something for your courage, or your tolerance. Either way, I am glad of the company. Stay a while and tell me how you have been.

lore7731_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly] [warmly teasing] There you are. Have you eaten, or have you been saving all your strength for telling me what a difficult day you have had? Come along. We will find time for both supper and the story.
lore7731_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Have you eaten, or have you been saving all your strength for telling me what a difficult day you have had? Come along. We will find time for both supper and the story.

lore7731_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [deadpan] [amused] Someone asked how much farther the road would take them. I said, axe me after supper. Yes, that was the joke. That groan is familiar. Give it a moment; it usually turns into a laugh eventually.
lore7731_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone asked how much farther the road would take them. I said, axe me after supper. Yes, that was the joke. That groan is familiar. Give it a moment; it usually turns into a laugh eventually.

lore7731_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [comforting] Sit. A good rest is part of getting through the next hard day. You can tell me about the battle once you have caught your breath. For now, let the fire and the company do their work.
lore7731_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit. A good rest is part of getting through the next hard day. You can tell me about the battle once you have caught your breath. For now, let the fire and the company do their work.
